fieldBindings.sourceRevisions: The input basis / file revisions the result was computed from, under the existing input-basis and source-identity authority.
fieldBindings.projectConfiguration: Project identity plus configuration facts: tsconfig/paths, .verterrc.json, lint preset, vite-config trust state, framework profile.
fieldBindings.engineIdentity: Engine kind and exact version: playground typescript@6.0.3, verter-tsc tsgo pin, or the resolved provider engine.
fieldBindings.hostIdentity: The executing host: server binary and version, editor client and version, MCP transport, or browser runtime plus WASM build selector.
fieldBindings.completenessState: One of the completenessStates enum; complete-empty is a successful empty answer and every other non-complete state is distinct from it.

distinctnessRule: complete-empty is a successful empty answer; partial, pending, unsupported, ambiguous, failed, cancelled and stale are distinct from it and from complete, and none of them may be published as a complete result.

currentSubstrate.binds: per-request observability records including flow-return payloads with partiality tags
engineIdentity for CLI and editor provider modes
hostIdentity for the browser product (local bundle / commit / release selector)
projectConfiguration lint preset and vite-config trust state

rules: Stale publication is forbidden: a result handle is checked against the current basis before display; old-source, old-project, old-engine, old-worker and wrong-handle results are rejected.
Cancellation prevents additional irrelevant work and releases retained handles; a cancelled request cannot warm a complete cache.
Receipts reuse the existing substrate (audit records, env-hash identity, engine pins) and add no second status store.
The receipt is bound before display, not reconstructed after the fact.
